intents.definition: The user wants to understand what a payment status means (pending, authorized, completed, failed, expired) or why a payment is stuck in that state.
examples: What does 'authorized' mean, is the money already mine?
Why is this transaction still pending after an hour?
dlaczego platnosc wisi w statusie oczekujaca
Co oznacza status 'expired' przy transakcji?
Klient zapłacił ale u was widzę 'failed', o co chodzi?
it's just sitting there not moving, is that normal??
Płatność autoryzowana czy to znaczy że zaksięgowana?
not: This is NOT payment_status_meaning if the payment is completed on our side but the shop platform shows it as unpaid — that is payment_not_reported.

intents.definition: The user's payment succeeded in kremzaPay but their shop still shows the order as unpaid, typically because the webhook notification did not arrive.
examples: Payment is completed on your side but my shop marks the order unpaid.
The webhook never reached my store, order stays 'awaiting payment'.
klient zaplacil a w sklepie dalej wisi nieoplacone
Zamówienie nie zmieniło statusu mimo udanej płatności.
u mnie w panelu ok, a sklep jakby nic nie dostal
can you resend the notification, my system didn't get it?
Zapłacone u Was, ale WooCommerce tego nie widzi.
not: This is NOT payment_not_reported if the user only asks what 'pending' means without a shop-vs-provider mismatch — that is payment_status_meaning.
This is NOT payment_not_reported if the customer was actually charged two times — that is payment_duplicate.

intents.definition: The user wants to turn on or configure a specific payment method for their own shop.
examples: How do I enable BLIK for my store?
Where in the Panel do I switch on Google Pay?
jak wlaczyc platnosci karta u mnie w sklepie
Chcę dodać pay-by-link do checkoutu, gdzie to ustawić?
moi klienci nie widza BLIKa na stronie, jak to odblokowac
need card payments live before the weekend, what do I click?
Da się skonfigurować przelewy tak żeby pojawiły się w koszyku?
not: This is NOT payment_method_enable if the user only wants to understand how a method works, not activate it — that is payment_method_question.

intents.definition: The user wants to understand how a particular payment method works, such as BLIK, Google Pay, QR codes, or pay-by-link.
examples: How does pay-by-link actually work for the customer?
Does BLIK need the app or just a code?
jak dziala platnosc przez kod QR
Czym różni się Google Pay od zwykłej karty u Was?
klient pyta czy blik dziala bez internetu, jak to jest
so with pay-by-link do they get a page or what?
Czy pay-by-link ma jakiś termin ważności?
not: This is NOT payment_method_question if the user wants to activate the method in their shop — that is payment_method_enable.

intents.definition: The user wants to know the minimum or maximum amount allowed per payment, or wants their transaction limit raised.
examples: What's the maximum single payment I can accept?
Can I raise my transaction limit above the default?
jaka jest minimalna kwota platnosci
Klient chce zapłacić 60 tysięcy, a system nie pozwala.
czemu nie przechodzi platnosc na 55 tys, za duzo?
we're onboarding a big client, need a higher cap asap
Czy da się podnieść limit pojedynczej transakcji?
not: This is NOT payment_limits if the question is about the minimum payout amount to the bank account — that is payout_when.

intents.definition: The user reports that a customer was charged more than once for a single order.
examples: My customer got charged twice for one order.
There are two identical transactions for the same purchase.
klient zaplacil dwa razy za to samo zamowienie
Widzę podwójną płatność na tę samą kwotę, jak to cofnąć?
chyba pobralo dwa razy, klient sie wkurza
she says her card shows the amount twice, help
Dwie takie same transakcje w minutę, to błąd?
not: This is NOT payment_duplicate if there is only one charge but the shop shows it as unpaid — that is payment_not_reported.

intents.definition: The user wants to set up recurring payments, card tokenization, or subscriptions from the merchant side.
examples: How do I set up monthly subscription charges?
Can I save a customer's card token for recurring billing?
jak ustawic platnosci cykliczne dla abonamentu
Chcę pobierać co miesiąc bez proszenia klienta o kartę za każdym razem.
potrzebuje zeby karta sie zapamietala i sciagalo automatycznie
we want a Netflix-style auto-renew, is that possible here?
Da się zrobić subskrypcję z tokenem karty?
not: This is NOT payment_recurring_setup if the user only wants to enable a method for one-off checkout — that is payment_method_enable.

intents.definition: The user wants to cancel an unpaid payment or asks about a payment session expiring.
examples: How do I cancel a payment the customer never completed?
The session expired before he paid, what now?
jak anulowac nieoplacona transakcje
Link do płatności wygasł, po ilu minutach to się dzieje?
klient nie zdazyl zaplacic i wszystko przepadlo
customer walked away, kill that pending link please
Czy sesja płatności ma limit czasu?
not: This is NOT payment_cancel_session if the customer already paid twice and wants one charge reversed — that is payment_duplicate.

intents.definition: The user wants to know when they will receive their money or how the payout schedule works.
examples: When do I actually get the money in my bank?
What's your payout schedule, daily or weekly?
kiedy dostane wyplate za wczorajsze platnosci
Za ile dni środki trafiają na konto?
sprzedalem dzis, kasa bedzie jutro czy pozniej
just started, no idea when the first transfer lands
Czy wypłaty są następnego dnia roboczego?
not: This is NOT payout_when if a scheduled payout was due but never showed up — that is payout_missing.

intents.definition: The user expected a payout that was due but it has not arrived on their bank account.
examples: My payout was supposed to arrive yesterday and it's not here.
No transfer landed even though the schedule says T+1.
brak wyplaty na koncie mimo ze mialo byc wczoraj
Środki nie doszły, a w panelu widnieje jako wysłane.
czekam juz dwa dni i nic nie przyszlo na bank
money's just gone missing, nothing hit my account
Wypłata oznaczona jako zrealizowana, ale na koncie pusto.
not: This is NOT payout_missing if the user only asks about the general schedule and nothing is overdue yet — that is payout_when.

intents.definition: The user wants to understand or reconcile a settlement report, including net versus gross, matching payouts to orders, or exporting the data.
examples: How do I match a payout to the individual orders inside it?
The settlement report shows net, where do I see gross and fees?
jak rozliczyc raport wyplat z zamowieniami
Nie zgadza mi się kwota wypłaty z sumą sprzedaży, gdzie różnica?
te liczby w raporcie sie nie skladaja, co jest netto a co brutto
need to reconcile last month's payouts, can I export this?
Czy mogę pobrać zestawienie transakcji do jednej wypłaty?
not: This is NOT payout_report_reconcile if a payout is simply missing from the account — that is payout_missing.
This is NOT payout_report_reconcile if the user wants an export purely for their accountant's bookkeeping — that is billing_accounting_export.

intents.definition: The user wants to change how often their payouts are made.
examples: Can I switch from daily payouts to weekly?
How do I change my settlement frequency?
jak zmienic czestotliwosc wyplat na tygodniowa
Wolałbym dostawać środki raz w tygodniu, da się?
codzienne przelewy mi nie pasuja, chce rzadziej
prefer one big transfer instead of many small ones, possible?
Czy mogę ustawić wypłaty co dwa tygodnie?
not: This is NOT payout_schedule_change if the user wants to change the destination bank account — that is payout_account_change.

intents.definition: The user wants to change the bank account that payouts are sent to.
examples: How do I update the bank account for my payouts?
We switched banks, where do I put the new IBAN?
jak zmienic numer konta do wyplat
Zmieniłem rachunek firmowy, gdzie wpisać nowy?
stare konto zamkniete, kase trzeba slac na inne
payouts should go to a different account from now on
Czy mogę podać inny numer konta do rozliczeń?
not: This is NOT payout_account_change if the user wants to change how often payouts happen, not where they go — that is payout_schedule_change.

intents.definition: The user wants to know how much commission kremzaPay charges them.
examples: What commission do you take per transaction?
How much do you charge on card payments?
ile bierzecie prowizji od platnosci
Jaka jest opłata za BLIK w moim przypadku?
chce wiedziec ile mnie kosztuje kazda transakcja
trying to work out my margins, what's your cut?
Czy prowizja jest taka sama dla każdej metody?
not: This is NOT fees_how_much if the user already has an invoice and wants a line item explained — that is invoice_understand.

intents.definition: The user wants to find or download their invoices.
examples: Where can I download my invoices?
How do I find last month's invoice in the Panel?
gdzie znajde fakture za wasze uslugi
Nie widzę faktury za czerwiec, gdzie jej szukać?
potrzebuje sciagnac fakture a nie wiem gdzie klikac
accountant's asking for the invoices, where are they?
Czy faktury są w panelu czy przychodzą mailem?
not: This is NOT invoice_where if the user found the invoice but doesn't understand a position on it — that is invoice_understand.

intents.definition: The user wants to understand the positions on their invoice, such as line items or VAT.
examples: What does this line item on my invoice mean?
Is VAT included in the amount shown on the invoice?
co oznacza ta pozycja na fakturze
Dlaczego na fakturze jest inna kwota niż suma prowizji?
nie rozumiem tego vatu na dole faktury
the numbers on this invoice don't add up for me, explain?
Czy ta opłata na fakturze to prowizja czy coś innego?
not: This is NOT invoice_understand if the user cannot locate the invoice at all — that is invoice_where.
This is NOT invoice_understand if the user only asks the general commission rate with no invoice in hand — that is fees_how_much.

intents.definition: The user wants exports or summaries of their billing data for accounting purposes, such as an annual summary or a file for their accountant.
examples: Can I export all transactions for my accountant?
Where do I get an annual summary for bookkeeping?
jak wyeksportowac dane do ksiegowosci
Potrzebuję zestawienia za cały rok do rozliczenia.
ksiegowa prosi o plik z wszystkimi transakcjami za rok
year-end is coming, need everything in one CSV
Czy mogę pobrać roczne podsumowanie opłat?
not: This is NOT billing_accounting_export if the user is trying to reconcile one specific payout against its orders — that is payout_report_reconcile.
